text: <s>[INST] What is the capital of France? [/INST] The capital of France is Paris.</s>
<s>[INST] Explain photosynthesis in simple terms. [/INST] Photosynthesis is how plants make food from sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide.</s>

<s>[INST] Write a haiku about autumn. [/INST] Leaves fall gently down
Whispering goodbye to summer
Golden carpet spreads</s>
<s>[INST] Describe the color blue. [/INST] Blue is a calm, cool color often associated with the sky and ocean.</s>
<s>[INST] How do I make coffee? [/INST] To make coffee, grind beans, add hot water, and let it brew for 3-4 minutes.</s>
<s>[INST] What is machine learning? [/INST] Machine learning is a way for computers to learn patterns from data instead of being explicitly programmed.</s>
<s>[INST] Tell me a fun fact about octopuses. [/INST] Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.</s>
<s>[INST] What causes rain? [/INST] Rain occurs when water vapor condenses into droplets that become heavy enough to fall from clouds.</s>
<s>[INST] How do I center a div in CSS? [/INST] Use display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; on the parent element.</s>
<s>[INST] What is the speed of light? [/INST] The speed of light is approximately 299,792,458 meters per second.</s>
<s>[INST] Explain gravity simply. [/INST] Gravity is the force that pulls objects with mass toward each other.</s>
<s>[INST] What are the primary colors? [/INST] The primary colors are red, blue, and yellow.</s>
<s>[INST] How does the internet work? [/INST] The internet connects computers worldwide, sending data in small packets through networks.</s>
<s>[INST] What is DNA? [/INST] DNA is the molecule that carries genetic instructions for all living organisms.</s>
<s>[INST] Describe a sunset. [/INST] A sunset paints the sky with warm oranges, pinks, and purples as the sun dips below the horizon.</s>
